void findLinks(int tx, int ty, int node) {

    memset(distCell, 60, sizeof(distCell));
    queue<Point> q;
    seen[tx][ty] = 1;
    distCell[tx][ty] = 0;
    q.push(Point{tx, ty});

            if (valid(nx, ny)) {

                addEdge(node, id[i][j] + tot, INF);

void enqueue(int u) {
    if (u != S && u != T && excess[u] > 0 && !active[u]) {
        active[u] = true;
        activeQ.push(u);

void pushFlow(int u, int v) {
    int d = min(excess[u], cap[u][v]);
    cap[u][v] -= d;
    cap[v][u] += d;
    excess[u] -= d;
    excess[v] += d;
    enqueue(v);
}

void relabel(int u) {
    int mn = INF;
    for (int v = 0; v < MAXV; ++v)
        if (cap[u][v] > 0) mn = min(mn, height[v]);
    height[u] = mn + 1;
}

void discharge(int u) {
    while (excess[u] > 0) {
        bool pushed = false;
        for (int v = 0; v < MAXV; ++v) {
            if (cap[u][v] > 0 && height[u] == height[v] + 1) {
                pushFlow(u, v);
                pushed = true;
                if (excess[u] == 0) break;
            }
        }
        if (!pushed) relabel(u);
    }
}

int maxflow() {
    memset(height, 0, sizeof(height));
    memset(excess, 0, sizeof(excess));
    memset(active, 0, sizeof(active));
